dedupe_keys.name: jtsb railway accident and serious incident investigation reports japan transport safety board

description: The Japan Transport Safety Board publishes a searchable collection of railway accident and serious incident investigation reports. The search page notes that each report carries a preface stating that the investigation was carried out under the Act for Establishment of the Japan Transport Safety Board to find the causes of the accident and resulting damage and to help prevent accidents and reduce damage, and that some prefaces are omitted for convenience. The Board's home page also lists aviation and marine cases, and the old ministry URL now redirects to the Board's own site. Coverage: railway accidents and serious incidents in Japan. Format and access: web search with individual report pages, in Japanese. Licence and cost: free to read; no reuse licence was found on the pages read. Caveats: Japanese only, and reports are narrative. It supports resilience and hazard exposure studies of railway failures, including earthquake and weather-related events. It relates to the RAIB reports and the NTSB CAROL database in the catalogue.
